## Review gate

- [ ] The deliverable is bounded and the affected canon layer is named
- [ ] Evidence is separated from interpretation
- [ ] Canon status and volatile material are explicit
- [ ] Source anchors and correction history are preserved
- [ ] Contradictions and sibling versions have not been silently flattened
- [ ] No canon promotion is implied without explicit approval
- [ ] The smallest useful change was chosen
